Tess (growth): Heads-up 1 Littoral Merchant meetup Thu. Quick checklist: tabletop poster, 75 stickers, 30 tees, 150 business cards, speaker slot 12m + Q. Need webinar prefill QR, lead-tags, and post-event nurture. Who owns what?
Ben (events): I'll own load-in and volunteers. Room opens 17:00, talk at 18:30. Need HDMI, power strip, and one folding table. Volunteers @Ava @Luis on shifts.
Rina (ops): Swag counts at staging: 70 stickers, 28 tees, 160 cards. Ordered 10 tees overnight. Courier pickup Wed 9:00. Badge CSV header: name,email,company,utm,source,interest. Use utm=littoral_merchant.
Kai (design): I'll export poster and 1-page print tonight. Headline idea: "Inference that scales with your app." Benchmark blurb: "~25% lower per-token cost in live tests" 1 ok to soften if needed. Will include QR area.
Tess (growth): Soft blurb is fine. Lead flow: onsite leads flagged interest:d and interest:p (dedicated/private). On-check add webinar opt-in. Send invite within 24h; Day3 reminder; Day7 recording. Tag CRM with source=meetup.
Ava (sales): Add column "sq_priority" based on onsite answers. Sales will triage within 48h; mark SLED/enterprise.
Ben (events): I'll bring a cable lock and clipboard. Can someone confirm Square reader?
Rina (ops): I'll pack Square + backup. Label-print command for badges: label-print --template badge_v2 --csv badges.csv --printer Zebra. I QA'd QR on Android/iOS.
Kai (design): Figma link: https://figma.com/file/littoral/kai-assets. Use navy #082a44 for prints. Promo code: LITT10.
LogiBot: Reminder scheduled -> courier pickup Wed 09:00; load-in Thu 16:30.
Tess (growth): Final owners: volunteers/load-in (Ben), swag & shipping (Rina), assets (Kai), lead flow & webinar (Tess). I'll post webinar invite copy tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
Ava: I'll ask the qualifying Q onsite.
Ben: Volunteers will run a 10m setup at 16:45.
Rina: Uploaded labels template to //shared/marketing/littoral_labels.csv"
